objectives_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
Sa fictional na kaso, gamit ang mock advisory, sabihin ang source/oras, kumpirmadong aksiyon at contact na kukumpirmahin.
Sa fictional na kaso, pumili ng gamit para sa fictional pamilya, ipaliwanag ang dahilan at petsa ng susunod na pag-check.
Sa fictional na kaso, sa mock team change, tukuyin ang dapat kumpirmahin at magbigay ng maikling handover nang walang personal na detalye.
Sa fictional na kaso, itugma ang apat na fictional pangangailangan sa tamang serbisyo at sabihin ang referral at follow-up.
Sa fictional na kaso, sa 10 minutong tabletop, ayusin ang prayoridad, handover, continuity, follow-up at suporta sa responder.
objectives_en: In a fictional case, on the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.
In a fictional case, using a mock advisory, state source/time, confirmed action and contact to verify.
In a fictional case, select items for the fictional family, explain why, and set a date to recheck.
In a fictional case, in a mock team change, identify what to confirm and give a short handover without personal details.
In a fictional case, match four fictional needs to the appropriate service and state referral and follow-up.
In a fictional case, in a 10-minute tabletop, sequence priorities, handover, continuity, follow-up and responder support.
summary_fil: Suriin ang panganib, maghanda, mag-ugnay ng serbisyo at balikan ang resulta.
summary_en: Assess risk, prepare, coordinate services and follow up.
